title: Replay advisory decisions with a strict scripted driver
narrative: Evaluation and CI need a first-class scripted driver that asserts expected yield kinds and fails when unexpected advice appears. Tracks R-IOC-REPLAY and R-IOC-OFFLINE[^insp-ioc-04].
implementation: `ScriptedDriver` / `durable_generator_host.run_soft_point_session` run start/resume with soft-point bindings and `strict_unexpected_advice`.
validation: Harness `cli` via `scenario.yaml`. Hard expects unexpected-advice failure when when_guidance is empty under strict mode.
